prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production prop atlas for Tequila Kill, completing the approved village kit.
REFERENCE 1 is the APPROVED in-game cream house: match its warm honey/amber wood, cream highlights, terracotta red, deep chocolate-brown stepped outline, softly shaded pixel-art volumes and upper-left daylight exactly. REFERENCE 2 is the approved whole-village composition: use the store, shed and yard props as guidance.
Make a transparent FOUR-COLUMN by TWO-ROW sheet, EIGHT separate reusable assets, one centered in each equal cell with wide transparent margins. No ground, floor, cast shadows, labels, text, panels, UI, characters or poster composition. Fixed overhead view showing tops and little FRONT faces facing DOWN the image. Clear crisp pixel clusters, soft material shading, no blur or photographic noise.
ROW1 left to right:
1. A low horizontal shop counter with a SMALL brass balance scale and one small cream sack, warm amber wood, about4:1 width to height, human-sized tabletop details rather than giant vases.
2. One small square open wooden produce crate filled with a few red apples and yellow oranges, top/front visible, no surrounding furniture.
3. A short horizontal shop shelf carrying three small clay jars and two tiny cream sacks, front face downward, about3:1 width to height.
4. A NARROW VERTICAL shop shelf/rack, extending UP/DOWN in the image, with three tiers spaced vertically, each carrying small jars and produce. Every jar's opening is at its TOP and front face points DOWN. This must be drawn in that orientation, never a horizontal shelf rotated90degrees: no sideways or upside-down jars. About1:3 width:height.
ROW2 left to right:
1. A small shed tool rack: shovel, hoe and coiled rope hanging from a short horizontal warm wooden rack, all upright, front faces downward.
2. One low wooden livestock trough with blue water, warm honey wood, about3:1, top/front visible.
3. One compact WOODEN western house matching reference1's view and scale: terracotta roof, small cream chimney, warm timber front, two blue windows, human-sized door and two short front steps. No porch fence or yard. About1.2:1 width:height. Complete house alone, no cut-off roof.
4. One low cluster of three small sage-green desert shrubs, warm sunlit olive/cream tips and deeper warm green shadows. No ground patch, no cactus, no flower pot.
Use the same consistent lighting and material contrast across all eight items. They belong in the same softly shaded pixel-art game as the reference house. Genuine transparent alpha.
